results.problem: minimum balanced element cut (vertex and edge separators)
results.bound: O(OPT_c \cdot \sqrt{(\log n)/\varepsilon})\)-approximation in O(n^\varepsilon m^{1+o(1)}) time
results.previous_best: O(\sqrt{\log n}) best-known polynomial-time approximation ratio via O(n) large SDP solves [18, 1]; O(OPT\sqrt{(\log n)/\varepsilon}) in O(n^{1+O(\varepsilon)} m^{1+o(1)}) max-flows [28]
results.quote: we give a (Monte-Carlo randomized) algorithm running in \(O(n^\varepsilon m^{1+o(1)})\) time that produces a \(\Theta(1)\)-balanced element cut of size \(O(OPT_c\cdot\sqrt{(logn)/\varepsilon})\) for any value \(\varepsilon\in[\Theta(1/log(n)),\Theta(1)]\).

results.problem: balanced vertex separator and balanced edge separator
results.bound: O(\sqrt{\log n})\)-approximation in O(m^{1+\varepsilon}) time for any fixed \varepsilon>0
results.previous_best: O(\sqrt{\log n}) best-known ratio but via slow SDP-based algorithms requiring O(n) large SDP solves [18, 1]
results.quote: Taking any fixed \(\varepsilon>0\), we obtain \(O(\sqrt{logn})\)-approximation in \(O(m^{1+\varepsilon})\) time. This approximation factor is the best known for both vertex- and edge balanced separators.

results.problem: minimum balanced element cut on graphs with padding bound
results.bound: O(OPT_c \cdot \sqrt{\beta}/\varepsilon)\)-approximation in m^{1+o(1)} n^\varepsilon \text{polylog}(n) time (O(\sqrt{\beta}) approximation in O(m^{1+\varepsilon}) time for fixed \varepsilon>0)
results.previous_best: O(\beta)\)-approximation via standard polynomial-time LP-based approach (e.g., O(\log h) for K_h-minor-free graphs [11])
results.quote: In particular, by taking any fixed \(\varepsilon>0\) we obtain an \(O(\sqrt{\beta})\) approximation in \(O(m^{1+\varepsilon})\) time.

results.previous_best: O(\log n) approximation via \widetilde{O}(m^{1.5}) strongly-polynomial max-flows [3] or O(n) large LP solves [30, 31]
results.quote: Taking \(\varepsilon=\Theta(1/logn)\), we obtain an \(O(logn)\)-approximation in \(O(T_{maxflow}(m,m)\cdot\text{polylog}(n))\) time.
